name: Ritz Carlton Coconut Grove, Miami
insider_take: This waterfront sanctuary in Coconut Grove perfectly captures Miami's sophisticated side, where Old World elegance meets tropical luxury just steps from Biscayne Bay.
whats_special: The Ritz-Carlton Coconut Grove sits in Miami's oldest neighborhood, featuring Italian Renaissance architecture and panoramic bay views. The hotel's unique position offers direct access to the Grove's bohemian charm while maintaining the refined luxury Ritz-Carlton is known for. The rooftop pool deck provides stunning sunset views over Biscayne Bay and the Miami skyline.
pro_tip: Book a bay-view room on floors 10-17 for the best panoramic vistas, and time your arrival for sunset cocktails at the rooftop bar – the golden hour views are absolutely spectacular.
dont_miss: Stroll through the historic Coconut Grove village just outside your door, explore the lush Kampong botanical garden (a hidden National Tropical Botanical Garden), and catch the weekend farmers market at Regatta Park. The nearby Vizcaya Museum & Gardens, a stunning Italian Renaissance-style villa, is just 10 minutes away.
pros: Iconic Ritz-Carlton luxury service and amenities
Prime Coconut Grove location with upscale shopping and dining
Stunning views of Biscayne Bay and Miami skyline
Exclusive STARS Program benefits through Marriott partnership
cons: Premium pricing typical of luxury Ritz-Carlton properties
Limited beachfront access compared to Miami Beach hotels
